confirmations_requested.ask: Call the Norte area chief: confirm whether LH-02 is actually stopped at N522-15 (radio says stopped, CMMS says operating). Nothing is moved from or to that place until confirmed.

decision_cruda.rationale: LH-01 is down at N600-09 (radio and CMMS agree). Likely repair is about 13:30. The stope holds 239 t at 11.9 g/t, which is about 91 oz, and it is now uncovered. LH-08 comes from the infrastructure heading DS-C538-01, which costs only 0.2 oz/h. Travel is 0.65 h, so it arrives about 10:10. Over roughly 6.3 loading hours at 25.4 t/h it moves about 160 t, or about 61 oz. The heading loss is about 1.3 oz, so the net gain is about 55 oz. Norte stockpile has room (242 of 450 t), so stockpile ore still counts. I did not take LH-09 because its heading is critical path at 4 oz/h. LH-10 is not available until 11:00, and a second loader there would add little because Norte is truck-limited. LH-02 is not touched because the radio and CMMS conflict (CONFIRM-01).
